title: Pulse-Resolved Identifiability: An Adaptive Design Principle for Separating Drift and Diffusion in Destructive Single-Cell Assays

creators.name: Devanik Debnath
creators.affiliation: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, National Institute of Technology Agartala, India

description: A reproducible theoretical and computational benchmark for separating relaxation, input gain, and diffusion intensity in a controlled Ornstein-Uhlenbeck model observed through destructive population snapshots. All numerical data are synthetic. No empirical biological dataset was analyzed. This JSON file is a metadata draft only; no Zenodo deposit or DOI minting is implied.
